name.ja: トイ・ストーリー4 バズ・ライトイヤー

description.ja: 映画『トイ・ストーリー4』より、「スペースレンジャー」バズ・ライトイヤーが登場！
description.en: From the movie "Toy Story 4 ", " Space Ranger" Buzz Lightyear appears!

description.ja: • 顔は細やかな分割で瞳や口内まで再現。表情変更パーツは充実の３種類！色分けは成形色で再現し、裏側から触ることで目線の変更も可能。
description.en: • The face is recreated with detailed divisions, including the eyes and mouth. There are 3 types of expression changing parts! The color coding is reproduced with molded colors, and you can change the perspective by touching it from the back side.

description.ja: • 顔周りのクリアパーツは２パーツで再現し、着脱が可能。
description.en: • The clear parts around the face are reproduced in two parts and can be attached and detached.

description.ja: • 左腕のメカデザインはシールで再現。さらに腕のパーツが開閉するギミック付き！
description.en: • The mechanical design of the left arm is reproduced with Seal. It also comes with a gimmick that allows the arm parts to open and close!

description.ja: • 胸部のスイッチを押すと、背中のウイングパーツが自動で展開！
description.en: • Press the switch on the chest to automatically deploy the wing parts on the back!

description.ja: • ハンドパーツは２種類付属し、さまざまなポージングを演出。
description.en: • Two types of hand parts are included to create various poses.

description.ja: • 足の裏に貼れるシールが２種類付属。
description.en: • Two types of seals that can be attached to the soles of the feet are included.

name.ja: トイ・ストーリー4 ウッディ
